title: AccountSnapshotResult
description: Issue #317 account-equity gate output. Returned by exec-svc's account_snapshot Activity. Carries the brokerage account's net-liquidation equity (Alpaca /v2/account 'equity', NOT 'buying_power') plus, since issue #323, the account 'cash' component. risk-svc fails closed when the relevant figure is zero/unavailable. Broker adapters that do not yet expose a real account endpoint return the documented sentinels (equity=0, cash absent) so the field shape stays stable while per-provider backfills land.

equity.description: Account net-liquidation equity in dollars at the moment of the check (Alpaca /v2/account 'equity', not buying_power). Retained for the #317 fail-closed contract and any equity-based consumers. A zero value means the figure was unavailable; consumers fail closed rather than passing an unbounded cap.

cash.description: Issue #323: account cash balance in dollars (Alpaca /v2/account 'cash'). The notional_cap_pct_of_capital_base gate uses the MTM-stable cost-basis capital base (cash + sum_open_notional) as its denominator instead of net-liq equity, so numerator and denominator share the same cost-basis open-notional term. Optional for back-compat with pre-#323 producers/records; a null/absent or zero cash makes the cap gate fail closed (rejects) rather than passing an unbounded cap.

account_number.description: Informational brokerage account identifier (Alpaca /v2/account 'account_number', e.g. PA3ER05HLHMB). NOT a credential and NOT used by any risk gate — surfaced only for dashboard account verification. Optional/absent for broker adapters or records that predate this field.

last_equity.description: Prior market-close net-liquidation equity in dollars (Alpaca /v2/account 'last_equity'). The dashboard's live intraday 'today' P&L is equity - last_equity. Informational only — NOT a credential and NOT used by any risk gate. Optional/absent for broker adapters or records that predate this field or a response that omits it; a null/absent value leaves the dashboard's 'today' figure to fall back to the last completed daily bar (never fabricated).

options_buying_power.description: Options buying power in dollars (Alpaca /v2/account 'options_buying_power') — the figure a broker 'insufficient options buying power' rejection is measured against. Issue #874: informational funding detail that explains a broker 'insufficient options buying power' rejection (unsettled funds under T+1 vs options approval too low vs cash account). NOT used by any risk gate. Optional/absent for broker adapters that do not expose it or records that predate this field.

options_approved_level.description: Options level the broker has APPROVED for the account (Alpaca /v2/account 'options_approved_level'; 1 = covered only, 2 = long calls/puts, 3 = spreads). Issue #874: informational funding detail that explains a broker 'insufficient options buying power' rejection (unsettled funds under T+1 vs options approval too low vs cash account). NOT used by any risk gate. Optional/absent for broker adapters that do not expose it or records that predate this field.

options_trading_level.description: Options level currently in EFFECT for trading (Alpaca /v2/account 'options_trading_level'); may be lower than the approved level. Issue #874: informational funding detail that explains a broker 'insufficient options buying power' rejection (unsettled funds under T+1 vs options approval too low vs cash account). NOT used by any risk gate. Optional/absent for broker adapters that do not expose it or records that predate this field.

multiplier.description: Buying-power multiplier (Alpaca /v2/account 'multiplier'): 1 = cash account (T+1 settlement applies to options buying power), 2/4 = margin. Issue #874: informational funding detail that explains a broker 'insufficient options buying power' rejection (unsettled funds under T+1 vs options approval too low vs cash account). NOT used by any risk gate. Optional/absent for broker adapters that do not expose it or records that predate this field.

pending_transfer_in.description: Inbound transfer not yet credited, in dollars (Alpaca /v2/account 'pending_transfer_in'). A freshly funded account shows its deposit here before it reaches buying power. Issue #874: informational funding detail that explains a broker 'insufficient options buying power' rejection (unsettled funds under T+1 vs options approval too low vs cash account). NOT used by any risk gate. Optional/absent for broker adapters that do not expose it or records that predate this field.
